newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle $1.00-2.00 higher - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle $1.00-2.00 higher - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00-2.00 higher. Trade active. Demand good. - USDA

Slaughter Steers: High Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1350 lbs 64.50-65.50. Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 63.50-64.50. Select 1-2 62.50-63.50. Select and Choice Holsteins 1-2 1300-1500 lbs 57.00-59.50.
Slaughter Heifers: High Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1125 lbs 64.00-64.50. Select and Choice 2-3 950-1100 lbs 62.50-64.00. Select 1-2 62.00-62.50.
